```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
xfun::pkg_attach("tidyverse", "magrittr", "xml2")

so <- params$so
volby_date <- params$volby_date
ns <- c(default = "http://www.volby.cz/senat/")
```

# Senátní obvod č. `r so`

```{r data-fetch}
get_obvod_xml <- function(so, volby_date) {
  paste0("https://www.volby.cz/appdata/senat/", volby_date, "/odata/obvody/vysledky_obce_obvod_", so, ".xml")|> read_xml()
}

res <- read_xml(paste0("https://www.volby.cz/appdata/senat/", volby_date, "/odata/vysledky.xml")) %>%
  xml_find_first(paste0(".//default:OBVOD[@CISLO='", so, "']"), ns)

res_towns <- get_obvod_xml(so, volby_date)

poradi <- res %>%
  xml_find_all("default:KANDIDAT", ns) %>%
  map(~ list(
    PORADOVE_CISLO  = xml_attr(.x, "PORADOVE_CISLO"),
    NAME            = paste(xml_attr(.x, "JMENO"), xml_attr(.x, "PRIJMENI")),
    HLASY_1KOLO     = as.numeric(xml_attr(.x, "HLASY_1KOLO")),
    ZVOLEN_1KOLO    = xml_attr(.x, "ZVOLEN_1KOLO")
  )) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(desc(HLASY_1KOLO)) %>%
  slice(1:4)

# Guard against < 5 towns
n_towns <- min(5, xml_find_all(res_towns, ".//default:OBEC", ns) %>% length())

obce <- xml_find_all(res_towns, ".//default:OBEC", ns) %>%
  map(~ list(
    NAZ_OBEC       = xml_attr(.x, "NAZ_OBEC"),
    VYDANE_OBALKY1 = xml_find_first(.x, ".//default:UCAST", ns) %>% xml_attr("VYDANE_OBALKY") %>% as.numeric(),
    VYDANE_OBALKY2 = xml_find_first(.x, ".//default:UCAST[@KOLO='2']", ns) %>% xml_attr("VYDANE_OBALKY") %>% as.numeric()
  )) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(desc(VYDANE_OBALKY1)) %>%
  slice(1:n_towns)
```

```{r helper-functions}
# Pull per-town vote counts for each candidate, for a given round's vote attribute
add_town_votes <- function(poradi_df, town_names, vote_attr) {
  for (name in town_names) {
    poradi_df <- poradi_df %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        !!name := res_towns %>%
          xml_find_first(paste0(".//default:OBEC[@NAZ_OBEC='", name, "']"), ns) %>%
          xml_find_first(paste0(".//default:HLASY[@PORADOVE_CISLO='", PORADOVE_CISLO, "']"), ns) %>%
          xml_attr(vote_attr) %>%
          as.numeric()
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
  poradi_df
}

# Build the stacked bar chart, summing "Rest" from the actual town columns
plot_votes_by_town <- function(df, total_col, town_names, title) {
  df <- df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(Rest = .data[[total_col]] - sum(c_across(all_of(town_names)))) %>%
    ungroup()

  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(all_of(town_names), Rest), names_to = "Town", values_to = "Votes") %>%
    mutate(
      NAME = factor(NAME, levels = df$NAME),
      Town = factor(Town, levels = rev(c(town_names, "Rest")))
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = NAME, y = Votes, fill = Town)) +
    geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Kandidáti", y = "Hlasy") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r round1-chart}
poradi1 <- add_town_votes(poradi, obce$NAZ_OBEC, "HLASY_1KOLO")
plot_votes_by_town(poradi1, "HLASY_1KOLO", obce$NAZ_OBEC, "Počty hlasů v 1. kole podle obcí")
```

```{r round2-chart}
poradi2 <- poradi %>%
  filter(ZVOLEN_1KOLO == "2.KOLO") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    HLASY_2KOLO = res %>%
      xml_find_first(paste0("default:KANDIDAT[@PORADOVE_CISLO='", PORADOVE_CISLO, "']"), ns) %>%
      xml_attr("HLASY_2KOLO") %>% as.numeric()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(poradi2) > 0) {
  poradi2 <- add_town_votes(poradi2, obce$NAZ_OBEC, "HLASY_2KOLO")
  plot_votes_by_town(poradi2, "HLASY_2KOLO", obce$NAZ_OBEC, "Počty hlasů v 2. kole podle obcí")
}
```
